props.text: Screen 6.1A-1. Full Add gateway form: name, actual gateway EUI, status interval, downlink priority, location and Submit.
Screen 6.1A-2. Entire blank device-profile form: check every required field before creating a profile.
Screen 6.1A-3. Existing commissioned EMU-01 AS923 profile: compare these values against the firmware.
Screen 6.1A-4. Entire Add application form: verify name and description before Submit.
Screen 6.1A-5. Entire Add device form: verify both EUIs, profile and frame-counter validation; never create a duplicate for a screenshot.
